$comment: Which launch cuts in studio/out/final/cuts/<slug>/ the Showcase publishes (cut.mp4, poster.jpg, item.json, optional captions.suggested.<locale>.vtt). Cut records carry no grade, so publishing is an explicit decision here. Owner-approved 2026-10-19: the 30 s trailer, the native 9:16 verticals and the making-of. Center-third verticals (a 16:9 clip in the middle third of a 9:16 canvas) are not published. scripts/import-showcase.ts reports any cut folder that is in neither list.
